title: Thaddeus strange message 1

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have received a new moon message from Thaddeus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have received a new moon message from Thaddeus.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I will play it now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will play it now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hope he gets to the point...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope he gets to the point...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hope he gets to the point...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hope he gets to the point...

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I know you probably been chasing ghosts and shadows for a while, but the road you travel shapes the way you walk. With one short leg, you go in circles unless someone gives you a leg up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know you probably been chasing ghosts and shadows for a while, but the road you travel shapes the way you walk. With one short leg, you go in circles unless someone gives you a leg up.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I am sorry that my former owner cannot find a quicker path to his point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am sorry that my former owner cannot find a quicker path to his point.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Nivalis was sucking the life out of my bones. But this place... it's like my mind is spinning away from my brain, and I can't pull it back into me without twisting it into a shape that doesn't process reality in the same way anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nivalis was sucking the life out of my bones. But this place... it's like my mind is spinning away from my brain, and I can't pull it back into me without twisting it into a shape that doesn't process reality in the same way anymore.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Actually... this message doesn't seem to come from Luna. It's a tight-wave broadcast, on an old frequency that's not blocked by the Comms embargo. Radio waves. He is close.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually... this message doesn't seem to come from Luna. It's a tight-wave broadcast, on an old frequency that's not blocked by the Comms embargo. Radio waves. He is close.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I am close. I'm stroking your hair now. Though I'm a couple of dimensions out of alignment with you. But you might still feel it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am close. I'm stroking your hair now. Though I'm a couple of dimensions out of alignment with you. But you might still feel it.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: The ticket. Egress. That's what you want to know about, right? Do you know why you're still chasing after a ticket? Chasing after me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The ticket. Egress. That's what you want to know about, right? Do you know why you're still chasing after a ticket? Chasing after me?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: No one is going to make your life simpler kid. Not your loved ones, not your friends. No one. The only person who can simplify your life is you. Will you choose to do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one is going to make your life simpler kid. Not your loved ones, not your friends. No one. The only person who can simplify your life is you. Will you choose to do that?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: You're the only one that's not tainted by me. By the pieces of me I scattered everywhere I went. Like pollen. Like mold. Stay clear of me, kid. Stay pure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're the only one that's not tainted by me. By the pieces of me I scattered everywhere I went. Like pollen. Like mold. Stay clear of me, kid. Stay pure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I DO have a lot of questions...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I DO have a lot of questions...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I DO have a lot of questions...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I DO have a lot of questions...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does it say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does it say?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Hey kid, I know you probably got a lot of questions, but trust me, answers just make your world smaller. I want to leave some wonder for you to discover.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey kid, I know you probably got a lot of questions, but trust me, answers just make your world smaller. I want to leave some wonder for you to discover.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't feel anything at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't feel anything at all.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't feel anything at all.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't feel anything at all.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Why ARE you trying to get to Egress? And Thaddeus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why ARE you trying to get to Egress? And Thaddeus?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm curious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm curious.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want to escape to wherever he went.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to escape to wherever he went.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want to escape to wherever he went.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want to escape to wherever he went.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel like something is pushing me towards him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel like something is pushing me towards him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I feel like something is pushing me towards him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I feel like something is pushing me towards him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava, this keeps going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava, this keeps going.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava, he has a point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava, he has a point.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That's the end of the message.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the end of the message.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I need to hear it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I need to hear it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do I need to hear it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do I need to hear it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Please don't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please don't.
